observations.explanation: Pages 5–7 describe the role assignment, turn-by-turn instruction/solution exchange, prompt rules, and task-done token; page 12 lists additional termination conditions. This supports a concrete protocol that is reproducible in principle.
Page 9 reports 25,000 AI Society conversations and 50,000 Code conversations, and describes the role, task, language, and domain generation steps. The resource-oriented characterization is warranted.

Pages 9–11 identify recurring issues including role flipping, repeated instructions, flake replies, and looping. Pages 12–14 report prompt ablations and the accompanying increase in flake messages, supporting the stated tradeoff.

Pages 12–13 report termination analyses and explicitly state that evaluating task-completion capabilities requires numerous domain experts. The observation appropriately distinguishes token-based termination from demonstrated task quality and limits the claim to conclusions about competence.
